def finish_release(spec, fragments, capacity):
    """Calibration, priority, backup tree, bank tables and certificate."""
    classes = spec['classes']
    width = spec['width']
    threshold = Fraction(spec['threshold'][0], spec['threshold'][1])

    clusters, noise = build_clusters(spec, fragments)
    rows = RowIndex(spec['validation'], classes)
    totals = [rows.total(cls) for cls in range(classes)]

    boxes = [(cluster['length'], tuple(pair[0] for pair in cluster['range']),
              tuple(pair[1] for pair in cluster['range'])) for cluster in clusters]
    coverage = batch_hits(boxes, rows)

    catalog_clusters = []
    geometry = {}
    scores = {}
    patterns = []
    for cluster, box, hits in zip(clusters, boxes, coverage):
        pairs = cluster['range']
        lo, hi = box[1], box[2]
        score = cluster_score(hits, totals, cluster['class'])
        kept = bool(score > threshold)
        scores[cluster['id']] = score
        geometry[cluster['id']] = {'length': cluster['length'],
                                   'class': cluster['class'], 'range': pairs}
        catalog_clusters.append({'id': cluster['id'], 'class': cluster['class'],
                                 'members': cluster['members'],
                                 'core': cluster['core'],
                                 'range': [list(pair) for pair in pairs],
                                 'hits': hits,
                                 'score': [score.numerator, score.denominator],
                                 'kept': kept})
        if kept:
            patterns.append((cluster['length'], lo, hi))

    priority = priority_order(catalog_clusters, scores)
    mode = spec['mode']
    if mode == 'range':
        # One entry per kept cluster; range counts are never clipped.
        entries = len(priority)
    else:
        entries = exact_entry_count(patterns, capacity['exact'])
    table = BankTable(geometry, priority)
    tree = BackupTree(spec['train'], width)

    catalog = {'id': spec['id'],
               'fragments': [list(triple) for triple in fragments],
               'noise': noise,
               'clusters': catalog_clusters,
               'priority': priority,
               'backup': tree.certificate,
               'entries': entries}
    return {
        'id': spec['id'], 'catalog': catalog, 'mode': mode, 'width': width,
        'classes': classes, 'packet_limit': spec['packet_limit'],
        'idle_us': spec['idle_us'], 'entries': entries, 'tree': tree,
        'table': table}
